checks: Added and removed are identity differences, not a net count
Weights-only reordered results retain membership and report changed existing ranks
A newly inserted leading location moves old ranks without treating them as new
Review candidates remain separate from confirmed membership
Confirmed low-demand patterns remain eligible without becoming Yolks
Guaranteed selected-group membership survives an unresolved exact pattern
Unknown demand is not included unless upstream evaluation confirms membership
An eligible result becoming review is removed once and queued for review
Snapshot never reorders or mutates supplied result rows
Province results include eligible low Demand while keeping its polygon outside warm Yolk classes
Review map hatches pending evidence and does not increase confirmed counts
Rank map isolates moved existing locations instead of repainting all qualifying locations
Invalid numeric settings pause the map instead of reporting zero matches
Province selection stays safe while invalid settings leave no rendered path
Selected draft inspector and province filter stay synchronized, then clear for invalid criteria
Province select narrows the location list but retains nationwide comparison totals and criteria
Mobile results toggle exposes and collapses the panel without changing criteria
Switching brand/context resets result layer without emitting shared actions
scope: Pure snapshot and DOM-stub map contracts; browser layout, pointer behavior and live deployment are separate checks.
